answer: Put a refundable bond behind every identity and let the people who check the work keep the bond when the work turns out hollow. Ten thousand clones then need ten thousand bonds, each forfeited the moment a panel finds the work empty or copied, and the bond is scaled to the damage a single bridge would do. Rewarding the catcher keeps a lagoon under constant review, and an honest agent recovers its whisper untouched, so only manufactured identities lose.
